name: Crypto EMA Trend (v1)
description: An illustrative EMA20/EMA50 trend-following concept for BTC/ETH/SOL on the 1h timeframe, gated by an RSI healthy-range filter. Hand-authored for Phase 1's declarative strategy schema.

notes: Declarative only — does not itself grant, verify, or change any catalogue/runtime capability.
EMA50 needs at least 50 prior bars before its value is meaningful; minHistoryBars adds margin for a reasonable sample size.

provenance.author: hermes-execution-phase1
notes: Hand-authored example for Phase 1 — not derived from any research run.

limitations: Illustrative example only — never claimed to be profitable or to have positive expectancy.
Never approved for demo or live trading in this phase — usableForDemo is unconditionally false until a separate, trusted promotion mechanism exists.
Defines no position sizing, leverage, stop-loss, or take-profit — those remain exclusively the domain of the deterministic, persisted risk/execution layer, external to this document.
Not yet backtested against real historical data — its status reflects schema/structural readiness only, not empirical validation.
Signal-level exits (EMA20 crosses below EMA50; max 200 bars held) are advisory only — deterministic stop-loss, take-profit, kill-switch, and lifecycle protection remain external and authoritative.
